description: Rename one of an MCP server's accounts (change its label). Only rename when the user asks for a new label, never as a step in fixing a connector. The account's server identifier changes with the label at the next listing, so after renaming, re-run GetMcpServerStatus (or GetDynamicTools) before calling that account's tools again. Stale identifiers fail cleanly. Call it only once the user has typed a request to rename that account by name: a yes to your question or a tap on an option does not count, so ask them to type the request themselves, such as rename my Weather work account to side, instead of confirming with a question widget.

account_label.description: The account's label exactly as shown by GetMcpServerStatus (account="…"); the quoted form is accepted verbatim.

server_id.description: The server identifier shown by GetMcpServerStatus. It is the same identifier that GetDynamicTools and CallDynamicTool address, e.g. "dashboard-team-1-Slack". Never a display name.
